steps.instruction: Hold the PEN hovering just above the CENTER of the tablet; don't press anything.
Slowly raise the PEN until it goes out of range, then bring it back. Repeat a few times.
Hover the PEN and move it slowly LEFT to RIGHT, then TOP to BOTTOM.
Hover the PEN at the TOP-LEFT corner of the active area.
Hover the PEN at the TOP-RIGHT corner of the active area.
Hover the PEN at the BOTTOM-LEFT corner of the active area.
Hover the PEN at the BOTTOM-RIGHT corner of the active area.
Press the PEN TIP down on the center, hold it, then lift. Repeat a few times.
Hover the PEN and press the LOWER barrel button (nearest the tip); hold it, then release. Repeat.
Hover the PEN and press the UPPER barrel button; hold it, then release. Repeat.
Press the PEN TIP down AND hold the LOWER barrel button at the same time.
Press the PEN TIP down AND hold the UPPER barrel button at the same time.
Hover the PEN, then lift it away quickly (proximity-out).
